GlidePath said it would own/manage the facility; no separate Quinbrook co-investment, equity partner or later sponsor transfer was found. The standalone record crosses the platform boundary. Quinbrook+1

Preserve Byrd Ranch/Byrd Ranch Storage LLC as GlidePath's 50 MW/50 MWh operating ERCOT project and legal SPV.
